note_text: Lymph node, mediastinal lymph node, excisional biopsy: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma. Immunohistochemistry: CD20 positive, CD10 negative, BCL6 positive, MUM1 positive. Cell of origin by Hans algorithm: ABC/non-GCB. MYC/BCL2 protein co-expression present (double-expressor). Ki-67 68%. Specimen adequate for ancillary studies.

FDG PET/CT (baseline). Hypermetabolic lymphadenopathy in 3 nodal regions including mediastinal lymph node, all on the same side of the diaphragm, SUVmax 11.0. No extranodal involvement. Impression: Lymphoma, Lugano stage II.
HBV screening before rituximab: HBsAg negative, anti-HBc IgG negative. Recorded in this note only (no structured laboratory rows in this extract).
Echocardiography: LVEF 61%, no regional wall motion abnormality (pre-anthracycline evaluation). Recorded in this note only (no structured procedure row).
Febrile neutropenia risk assessment (R-CHOP-21, age 59): intermediate; primary G-CSF prophylaxis not planned, G-CSF reserved for neutropenic complications.
